From `get_sizes_advanced`, the result is built iteratively:
- start with `width=711`, `height=1009`, offsets `(17, 29)`
- each loop computes `remaining = self.num_windows - len(results)`
- `_get_row_or_col` calls `calc(remaining, width, height)` to choose `(rows, cols, orientation)` minimizing `abs((width/cols)/(height/rows) - self.ratio)`
- then it emits either one full row (`ROWCOL`) or one full column (`COLROW`) worth of rectangles
- after appending, `get_sizes_advanced` shrinks the remaining area by the emitted row height or column width and updates offsets accordingly.
